Mali.title: The CNDH condemns the killings in Menaka and calls for investigations
Mali.summary: Nearly 60 bodies were discovered in a mass grave at a camp near Menaka. The information was announced last Friday by the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA), after attacks on several camps around the city. According to local sources, a massacre of civilians of such magnitude had not been reported in the region since 2020 .

Mali.title: Contre la Russie à tout prix : l‘Ukraine et les Touaregs du Mali
Mali.summary: L'Ukraine combat la Russie, peut-être jusque dans le Sahara. Selon une enquête de la chaîne américaine CNN, publiée en septembre 2026, une quinzaine de spécialistes ukrainiens des drones soutiendraient des rebelles touaregs dans le nord du Mali. Leur ennemi commun : les militaires au pouvoir à Bamako et leurs alliés russes.

Mali.title: Mali: thirteen civilians killed by an army drone strike, in the Timbuktu region
Mali.summary: In Mali, thirteen civilians, including six children, were killed, on the night of Sunday to Monday, October 26, by a drone strike by the Malian army, near Lerneb, in the Timbuktu region, according to information verified by RFI from many local sources. The General Staff did not communicate about this strike . Published on: The Malian army is fighting, with its Russian partners in the Africa Corps, jihadist or pro-independence groups active in the country.

Mali.title: The CNDH condemns the killings in Menaka and calls for investigations
Mali.summary: Nearly 60 bodies were discovered in a mass grave at a camp near Menaka. The information was announced last Friday by the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA), after attacks on several camps around the city. According to local sources, a massacre of civilians of such magnitude had not been reported in the region since 2020 .

Mali.title: bamako: a conv...
Mali.summary: According to the Directorate General of Trade, Consumption and Competition (DGCC), this is the largest convoy hosted in the capital since the beginning of October. The previous convoys consisted of 643 tanks on 3 October, 957 tanks on 10 October and 17 October 734 tanks. The DGCC recalls that 3,796 tanker trucks had arrived in Bamako during the month of September divided into five convoys .

Mali.title: 05:10 Diplomacy: MALI and GHANA SEAL A STRATEGIC and SECURITY PARTNERSHIP
Mali.summary: Received in audience this Monday, October 26, 2026 by the Prime Minister, Major General Abdoulaye Maïga, the new ambassador of Ghana to Mali, Lieutenant-Colonel Umar Sanda Ahmed, placed his mission under the sign of security cooperation, the opening up of Mali via Ghanaian ports and respect for the sovereignty and principles of the Confederation of Sahel States (AES) At the heart of this contact at the Primature, the Ghanaian diplomat reaffirmed his country's commitment to regional security as well as its firm commitment alongside Mali in the fight against insecurity and violent extremism .

Mali.title: Security situation by DIRPA: Six months of reconquest under the microscope
Mali.summary: In the theatre of operations, war obeys an implacable temporality, made up of tactical silences, logistical requirements and planned flashes. From April 25 to October 20, 2026, the Malian strategic arc went through one of the densest sequences in its modern history . Within the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA), Colonel-Major Bakary Bocar Maiga drew up before the national and international press, on Friday, October 23, 2026, the operational balance sheet of a reconquest carried out on all fronts, balance sheets finalized on October 20, 2026 .

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Bamako: Strengthening of fuel stocks with the arrival of a convoy of 1107 tanker trucks on Monday
Mali.summary: Bamako, October 26 (AMAP) The Directorate General of Trade and Competition (DNCC) announced the arrival of a convoy of 1107 tanker trucks, this Monday in Bamako, to strengthen the fuel stock, learned AMAP from a source close to the DGCC The same source specifies that a convoy of 1,107 tanker trucks arrived this Monday, October 26, 2026, at around 8 a.m. in the parking lots of Bamako after crossing the night, under the escort of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa).

Mali.title: Why Ukraine may be involved in Mali's conflict
Mali.summary: Ukraine is fighting Russia — and the conflict may extend into Africa's Sahel region. According to an investigation published by US media outlet CNN this month, around 15 Ukrainian drone specialists are reportedly supporting Tuareg rebels in northern Mali. Their common enemy: the military government in Bamako and its Russian allies.

Mali.title: Tagadayat: the army announces the discovery of 54 bodies
Mali.summary: RIGHT NOW A patrol found 54 bodies in a camp located southeast of Menaka, according to the General Staff of the Armed Forces. Nine survivors were evacuated to the city for treatment. The General Staff of the Armed Forces announced on Saturday, October 24, the discovery of 54 bodies in a camp in Tagadayat, about 35 kilometers southeast of Menaka .

Mali.title: Mali: actors mobilized to strengthen trust between security forces and populations
Mali.summary: Mali: actors mobilized to build trust between security forces and populations From 20 to 22 October 2026, a forum and a workshop brought together security forces, civil society organizations and local authorities around the strengthening of dialogue and trust between security actors and populations . Organized under the leadership of the Commissioner for Security Sector Reform (CRSs), with the support of EUCAP Sahel Mali, WANEP-Mali and the Platform for Exchange and Action, these meetings allowed participants to exchange on their experiences and identify avenues for common actions .

Mali.title: Mali: FAMa strike several terrorist positions in Koulikoro and Mopti
Mali.summary: Mali: FAMa strikes several terrorist positions in Koulikoro and Mopti The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, carried out several strikes against suspected terrorist groups in the Koulikoro and Mopti regions on 24 and 25 October 2026, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko According to the General Staff of the Armed Forces, the intelligence collected on 24 October made it possible to locate a group of terrorist elements with motorcycles and logistical means, about two kilometres south-west of the village of Kenenkoun, in the Koulikoro region.

Mali.title: A record for Bamako: 1,107 tankers secured by our valiant FAMa!
Mali.summary: This Monday, October 26, 2026, at around 8 a.m., a convoy of 1,107 tankers arrived in the parking lots of Bamako, after crossing the night under the escort of our valiant Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), which we salute for their commitment and courage . It is an exceptional volume: the largest convoy received in the capital since the beginning of October, after those of: October 3: 643 tanks; October 10: 957 tanks: October 17: 734 tanks.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: FAMa neutralize several terrorist positions in Koulikoro and Mopti
Mali.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing the permanent operations of surveillance, control and security of the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko . On October 24, 2026, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible to locate, about 2 km southwest of the village of Kenenkoun, in the Koulikoro region, a point of regroupment of terrorist elements with several motorcycles as well as logistical means.

Mali.title: Security situation: the army draws up a new inventory
Mali.summary: AT THIS TIME, the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA) held its traditional press briefing on the security situation, the operations carried out and those in progress throughout the territory. The consolidation of military positions in Kidal is one of the highlights of the period According to the Director of DIRPA, Colonel-Major Bakary Bocar Maïga, the offensive launched on October 6 as part of the "Dougoukoloko" operation allowed the FAMa to strengthen their system in the city and its surroundings.

Mali.title: Mali: a convoy of 1,107 tankers arrives in Bamako
Mali.summary: Mali: a convoy of 1,107 tanker trucks arrives in Bamako A convoy of 1,107 tanker trucks arrived in Bamako this Monday, October 26, 2026, at around 8 a.m., after a night journey under the escort of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa). This is the largest convoy received in the capital since the beginning of the month. Previous arrivals were recorded on 3 October (643 tanks), 10 October (957) and 17 October (734) .

Mali.title: After Kidal: The hunt for terrorists is open
Mali.summary: On October 6, 2026 at 1 p.m., the units of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) consolidated their system in Kidal, capital of the 8th administrative region. The listing isn't trivial. It is made by the Government Spokesperson, General Issa Ousmane Coulibaly, on behalf of the General Staff of the Armed Forces.

Mali.title: Mali: for Assimi Goïta, the difficult challenge of reconquest
Mali.summary: Six months after losing Kidal, the Malian army and its Russian allies have retaken this city, as strategic as it is symbolic, from the alliance of jihadists and separatists. But, for the transitional president, the hardest part remains to be done: securing the North and containing the persistent threat of Jnim on the rest of the country. The explosion reverberated throughout the city .

Mali.title: Displaced families in Yemen live in dire humanitarian situation
Mali.summary: Hundreds of displaced families from Yemen's Taiz and Lahj governorates are living in camps in Aden amid difficult living conditions and a continuing need for humanitarian assistance following a major Houthi offensive that started in September. In the Ras Imran area of Al-Buraiqeh district, the Al-Firdaws 1 and Al-Firdaws 2 camps contain approximately 850 tents sheltering displaced families.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: death penalty, road traffic, embezzlement... the main changes to the new Penal Code
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso adopted a new Penal Code on 20 October 2026. Reinstatement of the death penalty for certain offences, toughening of road penalties, penalties proportional to the amounts embezzled, new offences related to telephone communications, etc. The text introduces several changes in Burkina Faso's criminal legislation.

Burkina Faso.title: Back to News: The highlights of the week of October 19 to 25, 2026 in Burkina Faso
Burkina Faso.summary: Agriculture, energy, road safety and culture: the week of 19 to 25 October 2026 was marked by several decisions and initiatives in Burkina Faso. Back to the highlights. Burkina Faso accelerates its march towards food sovereignty .

Burkina Faso.title: Kombissiri: 25 young people arrested for road incivility and disruption of classes
Burkina Faso.summary: La Police nationale burkinabè a interpellé, le vendredi 23 octobre 2026, vingt-cinq jeunes, dont cinq filles, à Kombissiri, pour des faits d’incivisme routier et de perturbation des cours. Menées dans un lycée de la ville et aux abords du marché de Tuili, ces interpellations ont été déclenchées grâce aux signalements des populations. Les comportements inciviques sont dans le viseur de la Police nationale à Kombissiri.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina : 30 militaires et volontaires blessés bénéficient d’un programme spécial pendant leur convalescence
Burkina Faso.summary: Au Burkina Faso, l’association Africulture organise une formation artistique pour 30 militaires et volontaires blessés en opération. À travers les Ateliers des Héros, elle entend contribuer à leur reconstruction, en complément des soins médicaux et psychologiques. Au camp Général Aboubacar Sangoulé Lamizana de Ouagadougou, l’art devient un moyen d’accompagnement pour des combattants blessés en opération.

Burkina Faso.title: 66th anniversary of the national armed forces: The garrison of Dédougou begins its preparations with a popular cross-country
Burkina Faso.summary: The National Armed Forces launched, in Dédougou, in the Bankui region, the regional activities commemorating the 66th anniversary of their creation, on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, through a popular cross-country race followed by an aerobics session . As a prelude to the regional celebration of the 66th anniversary of the existence of the Burkinabe National Army on November 1, several preparatory activities are on display in Bankui and Sourou.

Niger.title: Algeria To Deploy Troops To Niger In First Foreign Mission In 53 Years
Niger.summary: By Enyichukwu Enemanna Algeria is to send troops to Niger in its first foreign deployment since sending forces to Egypt during the Arab-Israeli war in 1973. The deployment follows a visit to Algiers by Niger’s defence minister, as the country seeks support against armed groups, some of which are linked to al-Qaeda and Islamic State. Algeria has economic interests in Niger, including a planned gas pipeline that would carry Nigerian gas through Niger to Algeria.

Niger.title: Algérie-Niger : un premier déploiement militaire algérien à l'étranger
Niger.summary: Pour la première fois de son histoire, l'Algérie s'apprête à déployer des troupes hors de ses frontières. Le Parlement algérien a approuvé l'envoi de militaires au Niger, pays voisin confronté à une insécurité persistante due aux attaques de groupes djihadistes et à l'instabilité dans plusieurs régions du nord. Cette décision marque un tournant majeur dans la doctrine de défense algérienne et ouvre un nouveau chapitre dans les relations entre Alger et Niamey.

Niger.title: الجزائر الجيش الجزائري في النيجر… دلالات وأبعاد استراتيجية للقرار يرى الدكتور محمد الصالح جمّال، أستاذ العلوم السياسية والعلاقات الدولية أن مصادقة البرلمان على التماس إرسال مفرزة من الجيش الوطني الشعبي إلى النيجر، يعكس توجها استراتيجيا للرئيس عبد المجيد تبون، بصفته رئيسا… 2026/10/26
Niger.summary: الجيش الجزائري في النيجر… دلالات وأبعاد استراتيجية للقرار يرى الدكتور محمد الصالح جمّال، أستاذ العلوم السياسية والعلاقات الدولية أن مصادقة البرلمان على التماس إرسال مفرزة من الجيش الوطني الشعبي إلى النيجر، يعكس توجها استراتيجيا للرئيس عبد المجيد تبون، بصفته رئيسا للجمهورية والقائد الأعلى للقوات المسلحة ووزير الدفاع الوطني، يقوم على تعزيز قدرة الجزائر على حماية مصالحها الحيوية، وتطوير شراكاتها الإفريقية وفق رؤية تجمع بين السيادة الوطنية والمسؤولية الإقليمية.

Niger.title: Algeria’s president orders troop deployment to neighbouring Niger
Niger.summary: Algeria’s President Abdelmadjid Tebboune has ordered troops to neighbouring Niger to protect energy and economic interests shared by both countries. The decision, announced by Algeria’s presidency on Monday, came after both chambers of parliament approved the deployment in an emergency session on Sunday. Niger.title: Homeland security: 120 4×4 pickups and 100 motorcycles handed over to security forces
Niger.summary: The Directorate General of Resources of the Ministry of the Interior received, this Monday, October 26, 2026, a batch of equipment composed of 120 4×4 Sinotruk pickups intended for the National Guard of Niger and the National Police, as well as 100 motorcycles for the Road Police unit . Acquired from the State's own funds, this equipment aims to strengthen the operational capacities of the security forces in their missions of protecting people and property and defending territorial integrity .

Niger.title: تبون يصدر مرسوماً بإرسال قوات جزائرية إلى النيجر
Niger.summary: - التعاون العسكري بين الجزائر والنيجر: القرار جاء بعد توقيع اتفاق عسكري مشترك، وصوت البرلمان الجزائري لصالحه، مما يعكس مرحلة جديدة من التعاون الأمني والدفاعي لتأمين المشاريع المشتركة في ظل التهديدات الأمنية. - الجانب العملياتي والترتيبات اللوجيستية: القرار فتح الباب للترتيبات العملياتية واللوجيستية مع النيجر، بما في ذلك تحديد منطقة تمركز الوحدات، ويمثل أول إرسال لقوات جزائرية إلى الخارج منذ الاستقلال.

Niger.title: "جيل جديد" يعلّق على إرسال وحدات من الجيش إلى النيجر.. ما موقفه؟
Niger.summary: 26 أكتوبر 2026دعا حزب "جيل جديد" إلى ضبط أهداف ومجال مهمة وحدات من الجيش الوطني الشعبي في النيجر، وتحديد مدتها وشروط إنهائها بوضوح، مؤكدة أن حماية المصالح الاستراتيجية والطاقوية للجزائر لا ينبغي أن تقود إلى انخراط عسكري مفتوح خارج الحدود. وجاء موقف الحركة في بيان صدر عقب مصادقة غرفتي البرلمان، المجلس الشعبي الوطني ومجلس الأمة، يوم الأحد (أمس)، على قرار إرسال وحدات من الجيش الوطني الشعبي إلى النيجر، قبل أن تصدر رئاسة الجمهورية بيانًا بشأن القرار اليوم الاثنين.

Niger.title: Niger: 120 4×4 vehicles and 100 motorcycles approved for the benefit of the National Guard and the Road Police
Niger.summary: Niamey, Oct 26 (ANP)- The Director General of Resources of the Ministry of the Interior, Public Security and Territorial Administration, Commander Hamidou Soumana, received, this Monday, October 26, 2026, a batch of equipment composed of 120 4×4 vehicles and 100 motorcycles intended for the National Guard and the Road Police . The 120 4×4 vehicles are intended for the National Guard (GNN) and the 100 motorcycles for the Road Police unit.

Niger.title: Agadez/Security: In Bilma, Brigadier General Ibroh Amadou Bacharou reaffirms the CNSP's commitment to ensuring security in Niger
Niger.summary: Brigadier General Ibro Amadou Bacharou, Special Chief of Staff of the President of the Republic, accompanied by Brigadier General Abdourahamane Abou Zataka, Chief of Staff of the Army, and several civilian and military personalities, carried out, on Friday, October 23, 2026, a working mission to Dirkou, in the department of Bilma, Agadez region . This visit was marked by a collective prayer and a large popular meeting during which the administrative authorities and representatives of the populations expressed their concerns and reaffirmed their commitment to peace, security and the rebuilding of Niger .

Niger.title: Tillabéri/Infrastructure: Minister Salissou Mahaman Salissou assesses the work of the Farié-Téra road and the impact of the Garbougna structure
Niger.summary: The Minister of Equipment and Infrastructure, Colonel-Major Salissou Mahaman Salissou, made a visit on Friday, October 23, 2026, to the Farié-Téra axis, in the Tillabéri region. On the agenda, the monitoring of the rehabilitation work of this road and the evaluation of a crossing structure built in Garbougna to end the seasonal isolation of this locality . Through these two stages, the Minister took stock of the achievements, the remaining work and the measures taken to continue the work in a difficult security context.

Niger.title: Algeria to send troops to Niger in first foreign deployment since 1973 The troops are expected to protect energy facilities in northern Niger, near the Libyan border. 2 hrs ago Africa
Niger.summary: Algeria to send troops to Niger in first foreign deployment since 1973 Algeria is to send troops to Niger in its first foreign deployment since sending forces to Egypt during the Arab-Israeli war in 1973. The deployment follows a visit to Algiers by Niger's defence minister, as the country seeks support against armed groups, some of which are linked to al-Qaeda or Islamic State.

Niger.title: Algerian parliament approves army deployment to Niger
Niger.summary: A military parade takes place during the 2026 graduation ceremony at the Houari-Boumediene Military Academy in Cherchell, Algeria on July 9, 2026. /VCG File Algerian lawmakers on Sunday approved deploying People's National Army detachments to Niger, according to official statements from both chambers of parliament. During closed-door sessions, Algeria's Council of the Nation and People's National Assembly, the upper and lower houses of parliament, respectively, validated the presidential notification submitted by President Abdelmadjid Tebboune under Article 91 of the Constitution.

Niger.title: Algerian upper house of parliament approves troop deployment to Niger
Niger.summary: Algeria’s upper house of parliament has approved deploying troops to Niger to protect its energy facilities. The country’s Council of Nations approved the deployment during an emergency session on Sunday, while the lower house is expected to hold a session on Monday. If the deployment is approved in the lower parliament, it means the country is highly likely to deploy troops to protect its facilities located along the border area in the north of Niger, particularly the Kafra oil region and other energy facilities linked to Algeria’s state-owned energy company Sonatrach.

Niger.title: Algeria to send troops to Niger in first foreign deployment in over 50 years
Niger.summary: Algeria’s parliament on Sunday approved a resolution to send troops to Niger, making the first time Algerian soldiers will be deployed abroad since the 1973 Arab-Israeli war. Niger faces persistent attacks by armed groups, including near its border with Algeria, and the deployment comes as Algiers and Niamey are building the Trans-Saharan Gas Pipeline after decades of delays.

Niger.title: Algeria’s military deployment to Niger: What’s behind the move?
Niger.summary: Algeria’s parliament has approved a proposal to deploy troops to neighbouring Niger, in a major shift in the North African nation’s noninterventionist military doctrine. Algeria’s lower house, the People’s National Assembly, ratified the deployment on Sunday after the upper house, the Council of the Nation, unanimously approved the proposal earlier in the day.

Niger.title: Afrique: Des soldats algériens au Niger
Niger.summary: Le Parlement algérien a approuvé dimanche à l'unanimité le déploiement d'unités de l'Armée nationale populaire au Niger. Ce serait la première intervention militaire de l'Algérie à l'étranger depuis l'envoi de troupes en soutien à l'Égypte lors de la guerre de 1973. Les soldats algériens doivent s'installer à Madama, dans le nord du Niger, près de la frontière libyenne, sur le site d'une ancienne base française utilisée lors de l'opération Barkhane.

Niger.title: Algeria: Parliament approves deployment of troops to Niger
Niger.summary: On Sunday, October 25, 2026, the Algerian Parliament approved the sending of army units to Niger. This decision, which marks a break with the traditional doctrine of military non-intervention abroad, aims in particular to protect Algerian energy interests in the Sahelian country, Al Jazeera reports. Algeria reaches a major milestone in its military cooperation with Niger .

Niger.title: Sahel: Algerian parliament authorizes sending troops to Niger
Niger.summary: Algeria is taking a new step in its security rapprochement with Niger. On Sunday, October 25, 2026, the Council of the Nation, the upper chamber of the Algerian Parliament, unanimously approved a decision authorizing the dispatch of a detachment of the National People's Army (ANP) to Niger This initiative comes in a context of strengthening military cooperation between Algiers and Niamey, against the backdrop of security threats in the Sahel and strategic economic interests.

Niger.title: مغامرة عسكرية في النيجر تهدد الجزائر بالغرق في "مستنقع الساحل"
Niger.summary: تغامر الجزائر بالدخول في واحدة من أكثر البيئات الأمنية اضطرابا في إفريقيا، بعدما فتحت الموافقة البرلمانية المعلن عنها، أمس الأحد، الباب أمام إرسال وحدات من الجيش إلى النيجر، في خطوة يصعب فصلها عن تراجع نفوذها الدبلوماسي في منطقة الساحل، ومحاولتها استعادة موقع إقليمي بات عرضة لتغير التحالفات وتصاعد المنافسة بين القوى الخارجية.

Niger.title: Le parlement algérien vote l’envoi de soldats au Niger voisin
Niger.summary: Le Conseil de la Nation, la chambre haute, puis l’Assemblée populaire nationale, la chambre basse, ont toutes les deux voté dimanche l’envoi de troupes militaires au Niger. Par Nathalie Prévost Le scrutin avait été convoqué par le président de la République dans le cadre de séances plénières extraordinaires à huis-clos dont l’ordre du jour n’avait pas officiellement été communiqué.

Niger.title: Border security and energy interests.. What is behind Algeria's decision to send troops to Niger?
Niger.summary: The Algerian parliament, in its two chambers, the People's National Assembly and the National Assembly, on Sunday, approved the request of President Abdelmadjid Tebboune to send units of the Algerian army to Niger, with the aim of protecting the strategic interests of the country and securing the investment projects of the state company Sonatrach, in response to a request from the Nigerian authorities.

Niger.title: Nigerien, 3 others nabbed over guard’s killing, theft
Niger.summary: Operatives of the Edo State Police Command have arrested a Niger Republic national and three others over the alleged killing of a security guard and theft of goods worth over N400 million in the state. The suspects, identified as Hamisu Nuhu, Suleiman Rabiu, Hussaini Gago, a Nigerien, and Ibrahim Haruna, were arrested in connection with a robbery at Paparazzi Communication Complex in Auchi, Etsako West Local Government Area, on July 12, 2026.

Good day. This is Sultana Al-Qahtani with the Sahel Desk.

Daily bottom line for 2026-10-26: Reporting dated 2026-10-26 gives the desk 1 incident account to examine in Mali. None has support from a second independent source. The record is provisional; it does not establish the full extent of violence that day.

Mali: 23 retained reports. 1. The CNDH condemns the killings in Menaka and calls for investigations. Nearly 60 bodies were discovered in a mass grave at a camp near Menaka. The information was announced last Friday by the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA), after attacks on several camps around the city. According to local sources, a massacre of civilians of such magnitude had not been reported in the region since 2020 . 2. Contre la Russie à tout prix : l‘Ukraine et les Touaregs du Mali. L'Ukraine combat la Russie, peut-être jusque dans le Sahara. Selon une enquête de la chaîne américaine CNN, publiée en septembre 2026, une quinzaine de spécialistes ukrainiens des drones soutiendraient des rebelles touaregs dans le nord du Mali. Leur ennemi commun : les militaires au pouvoir à Bamako et leurs alliés russes. 3. Mali: thirteen civilians killed by an army drone strike, in the Timbuktu region. In Mali, thirteen civilians, including six children, were killed, on the night of Sunday to Monday, October 26, by a drone strike by the Malian army, near Lerneb, in the Timbuktu region, according to information verified by RFI from many local sources. The General Staff did not communicate about this strike . Published on: The Malian army is fighting, with its Russian partners in the Africa Corps, jihadist or pro-independence groups active in the country.

Burkina Faso: 5 retained reports. 1. Burkina Faso: death penalty, road traffic, embezzlement... the main changes to the new Penal Code. Burkina Faso adopted a new Penal Code on 20 October 2026. Reinstatement of the death penalty for certain offences, toughening of road penalties, penalties proportional to the amounts embezzled, new offences related to telephone communications, etc. The text introduces several changes in Burkina Faso's criminal legislation. 2. Back to News: The highlights of the week of October 19 to 25, 2026 in Burkina Faso. Agriculture, energy, road safety and culture: the week of 19 to 25 October 2026 was marked by several decisions and initiatives in Burkina Faso. Back to the highlights. Burkina Faso accelerates its march towards food sovereignty . 3. Kombissiri: 25 young people arrested for road incivility and disruption of classes. La Police nationale burkinabè a interpellé, le vendredi 23 octobre 2026, vingt-cinq jeunes, dont cinq filles, à Kombissiri, pour des faits d’incivisme routier et de perturbation des cours. Menées dans un lycée de la ville et aux abords du marché de Tuili, ces interpellations ont été déclenchées grâce aux signalements des populations. Les comportements inciviques sont dans le viseur de la Police nationale à Kombissiri.

Niger: 22 retained reports. 1. Algeria To Deploy Troops To Niger In First Foreign Mission In 53 Years. By Enyichukwu Enemanna Algeria is to send troops to Niger in its first foreign deployment since sending forces to Egypt during the Arab-Israeli war in 1973. The deployment follows a visit to Algiers by Niger’s defence minister, as the country seeks support against armed groups, some of which are linked to al-Qaeda and Islamic State. Algeria has economic interests in Niger, including a planned gas pipeline that would carry Nigerian gas through Niger to Algeria. 2. Algérie-Niger : un premier déploiement militaire algérien à l'étranger. Pour la première fois de son histoire, l'Algérie s'apprête à déployer des troupes hors de ses frontières. Le Parlement algérien a approuvé l'envoi de militaires au Niger, pays voisin confronté à une insécurité persistante due aux attaques de groupes djihadistes et à l'instabilité dans plusieurs régions du nord. Cette décision marque un tournant majeur dans la doctrine de défense algérienne et ouvre un nouveau chapitre dans les relations entre Alger et Niamey. 3. الجزائر الجيش الجزائري في النيجر… دلالات وأبعاد استراتيجية للقرار يرى الدكتور محمد الصالح جمّال، أستاذ العلوم السياسية والعلاقات الدولية أن مصادقة البرلمان على التماس إرسال مفرزة من الجيش الوطني الشعبي إلى النيجر، يعكس توجها استراتيجيا للرئيس عبد المجيد تبون، بصفته رئيسا… 2026/10/26. الجيش الجزائري في النيجر… دلالات وأبعاد استراتيجية للقرار يرى الدكتور محمد الصالح جمّال، أستاذ العلوم السياسية والعلاقات الدولية أن مصادقة البرلمان على التماس إرسال مفرزة من الجيش الوطني الشعبي إلى النيجر، يعكس توجها استراتيجيا للرئيس عبد المجيد تبون، بصفته رئيسا للجمهورية والقائد الأعلى للقوات المسلحة ووزير الدفاع الوطني، يقوم على تعزيز قدرة الجزائر على حماية مصالحها الحيوية، وتطوير شراكاتها الإفريقية وفق رؤية تجمع بين السيادة الوطنية والمسؤولية الإقليمية.
